title: Ambient: a slow constellation
summary: A model-free song patch with an interactive walkthrough; sound starts only when you choose.

steps.title: Start listening
steps.text: Press Start on the output to enable sound, then play the transport if it is paused. Start with a low system volume. The scope is the only visual: it shows the actual sound.
steps.hint: Audio requires your own Start gesture; loading or queueing this workflow does not start sound.

steps.title: Set the pulse
steps.text: The project clock drives all three parts. Try a small change in tempo or swing and listen to the relationship between the parts.
steps.hint: The timeline and this transport share the project clock.

steps.title: Edit the melody
steps.text: Click a piano-roll cell to place or remove a note; drag to draw a phrase. Listen to the spaces between notes.
steps.hint: Use the octave and transpose controls to find another register.

steps.title: Shape the low part
steps.text: Change the bass notes, then adjust the low voice filter and envelope. Solo its mixer channel to hear it on its own.
steps.hint: A longer release overlaps notes; a lower cutoff softens the sound.

steps.title: Make the rhythm your own
steps.text: Draw hits in the drum grid. Shift-click makes an accent and Alt-click makes a ghost hit. Mute or solo the drum channel to compare the arrangement.
steps.hint: The sparse percussion is optional; mute it for a beatless version.

steps.title: Create space
steps.text: Adjust the delay mix and feedback, then the reverb mix. Bring the melody channel down if the echoes cover the bass or drums.
steps.hint: The effects process only the melody; the bass and drums remain clear.

steps.title: Perform and finish
steps.text: Use the mixer mute and solo buttons to bring parts in and out. Press Stop on the output when finished; record with the output record button if you want to keep a take.
steps.hint: Try an introduction with only the melody, then add bass and rhythm one at a time.
